notes.title: The Emporium, New Marbles, & More!
notes.content:
Update 1.2

Check out the new content in Update 1.2 today!


 The Emporium
This update introduces a new special boss shop, the Emporium! 
The Emporium allows you to use the Destroyer and Leveler to have greater control over your marbles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/12cf6f1901e88943e96c4b46d87d1cf77163d203.png




Stickers
The Emporium also introduces Stickers, which can drastically change how a marble works. Check out all 30 today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/4b87dcbb33f5a8635302bbb7fe0f5cf1724877aa.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/538d11e50bf2e8c4cddd5084ef2ee646123af30a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/445f4d9d61c138c6213c704262908c02d75ce924.png




New Marbles
But wait, there is MORE! This update also includes 15 new marbles, 2 new items, 2 new skips and 1 new dispenser!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/259e7eeeb178dc9f0e7314b8427f2f17437dba7b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/9dbc08e1f582ba4df044cce27f8cc1d09b58f7e0.png




New Menu Options
There are now two new highly requested menu options

Game Speed increases the rate at menus move up to 400% faster

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/1db25c550df46a965bdf3192a3e167d65fcf5780.png



Marble Level Numbers shows each marble level over 1 as a persistent number

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/1a2bbfde20038a69e193a915a8ba74ed6cad816b.png


Stay chill Marblers!

Ideas Per Second







Detailed Change Notes

Balance
Decreased Traveler from 25 -> 15
Decreased round score add from 2000 -> 1800
Endless now scales exponentially 

Bugs
Fixed issue with pause menu soft locking the game in rare cases
Fixed issue with info notes on controller
Fixed some menus not working right with controller
Fixed round issues on Competitor
Fixed issues with quick restart
Fixed issue with Cracked

notes.title: New Marbles, Saved Games, & More!
notes.content:
Update 1.1

Check out the new marbles in Update 1.1 today!

This update includes 15 new marbles, 3 new power marbles, and 1 new dispenser!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/0b455eeb3f8da0d41bc8bd69153606829f722040.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/ba609273e2123d6e94e9e067816fd30bb2ef58d2.png



Save System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/700afa52aaed97e5a2d262c597a81841234993c1.png

This update also introduces a new save system! Quit the game, and return right where you left off!



Boss Rework

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/8df051f83872c8fbe4a3f4950d74fea0229a0032.png

Several bosses have been reworked to provide more interesting challenges, check them out!



Demo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/35c1906b7029e39279ce55998ff6c674fea8461e.png

A demo version of Ringer is now available on Steam! Try out the game with a limited number of marbles to get a feel for the game!



Stay chill Marblers!

Ideas Per Second







Detailed Change Notes

Balance
Comet now gains levels for each other comet in the ring at the end of a round
Cracked is now returned to the dispenser when hit, but keeps its current Mult
Cracked has changed rarity from Common -> Uncommon
Crown reduced from 2 -> 1
The Fire Dispenser is increased from $15 -> $40
Wheat increased from 0.2 -> 0.3
Endless score add increased from 10000 -> 30000
Strength increased from -200 -> -400
Robber now deducts money while outside of the ring
Baron increased from -4000 -> -6000
Imploder increased from -2% -> -5%
Imploder must now be hit to reduce value
Grenade now pushes marbles away when it stops in the ring
Trash now gains score when marbles are discarded
Boss Reroll reduced from $20 -> $10

Bugs
Fixed issue with physics not working correctly with follow shots
Fixed issue with enemy marbles not leveling up correctly
Fixed issue where picking up Crown could softlock the game
Fixed issue with SD Card where it would not allow access to the first round in a level

notes.title: Content Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First off, I wanted to thank everyone who has played Ringer during its launch week!

We hit Positive on Steam in under 1 week, thank you all! It took Cosmic Cursor months to do the same, so I can't thank you all enough!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/cc53e95b13d66ad0065c394c7f62b9716b8609e8.png


I want to address some of the concerns I have seen over the last week about content in Ringer.

Drum roll please . . . . . . . More content is coming soon!

I am currently working on 15 new marbles that will be released as soon as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/0829e872d25531a007ba2d0fa092b49ee05445b8.png


I am also working on a few new dispensers, but those may take a bit longer

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331918/0a876ecb066056b552a527bfa5be6f8c9ff6f36a.png


Thank you all so much for playing Ringer!
